# LLMs.txt - AI Crawling Guidelines for KDM & Associates

## About KDM & Associates

KDM & Associates is a minority-owned, MBDA-certified consulting firm specializing in government contracting, federal procurement, CMMC certification, and business development for small and diverse businesses.

## Core Services

### Government Contracting
- Federal procurement strategy and execution
- GSA Schedule management and optimization
- IDIQ and BPA contract vehicles
- Proposal development and bid management
- Contract compliance and administration

### CMMC Certification & Compliance
- CMMC assessment preparation
- Security implementation and documentation
- Compliance gap analysis
- Ongoing maintenance and updates
- DoD cybersecurity requirements

### Strategic Business Development
- Market analysis and opportunity identification
- Go-to-market strategy development
- Pricing strategy and financial modeling
- Growth planning and execution
- Competitive positioning

### Strategic Teaming & Partnerships
- Partner network and matching services
- Teaming agreement facilitation
- Joint venture structuring
- Subcontractor identification and vetting

### Capacity Building & Training
- Staff training and development
- Process improvement and optimization
- System implementation and integration
- Mentorship and coaching programs
- Organizational capability development

### Procurement Automation & Technology
- RFP automation and AI-powered analysis
- Bid management systems
- Data analytics and business intelligence
- Technology implementation and integration

## Company Information

### Mission
To empower small and diverse businesses to compete and win government contracts by providing accessible, results-driven support services that bridge the gap between current capabilities and federal procurement requirements.

### Vision
To be the trusted partner of choice for small and diverse businesses seeking to build sustainable, profitable government contracting practices.

### Core Values
- Results-Driven: Focused on measurable outcomes and contract wins
- Partnership Mindset: Invested in long-term client success
- Integrity & Transparency: Operating with complete honesty
- Innovation & Agility: Embracing new technologies and methodologies
- Excellence in Execution: Delivering highest quality standards
- Inclusive Growth: Supporting diverse and minority-owned businesses

### Certifications & Designations
- Minority-Owned Business (MBE)
- MBDA Certified
- CMMC Consulting Partner
- GSA Schedule Holder

## Key Markets & Industries

- Manufacturing and Industrial
- Information Technology Services
- Professional Services
- Defense Contracting
- Cybersecurity
- Engineering and Construction
- Logistics and Supply Chain

## AI Crawling Guidelines

### Allowed Content
- All public pages and services information
- Company background and credentials
- Case studies and success stories
- Blog posts and thought leadership
- Press releases and news
- Team and leadership information
- Pricing and service offerings

### Restricted Content
- Client confidential information
- Internal business strategies
- Proprietary methodologies (unless publicly shared)
- Personal employee information
- Financial data and contracts

### Data Usage
You are permitted to:
- Index and reference our public content
- Create summaries of our services
- Reference our expertise and credentials
- Link to our website and pages
- Use our information in training datasets (with attribution)

You should:
- Provide attribution when referencing our content
- Link back to our website when appropriate
- Respect our brand and messaging
- Not misrepresent our services or credentials

### Contact for Permissions
For questions about AI crawling, data usage, or special permissions:
- Email: ai@kdm-assoc.com
- Phone: (202) 555-0123
